title: AFK Time Tracker
description: Tracks how much time players spend while AFK and displays it in the statistics menu.
body:
## AFK Time Tracker
This mod tracks how much time players spend while AFK and displays it in the statistics menu.

![The "Time Spent AFK" entry on the statistics menu](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/69117b9dd8523a40012e5bc4fb06e5f794d81d82_0.webp)

#### Installation
---
- Using Modrinth app, just click on the Download button.
- Drop the jar inside your `mods/` directory.

#### Customization
---
You can customize the mod using the following commands:

| Command                             | Function                                                                              |
| ----------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `/afktracker threshold <seconds>`   | If a player spends this amount of seconds without moving, they get flagged as AFK.    |
| `/afktracker messages <true\|false>`| Whether if you want players to receive messages when their AFK status changes or not. |
